Title: Data Scientist (Risk)
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who'll effectively assess and manage risk by developing policies, methodologies, models, and systems for risk quantification, reporting, and monitoring.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing


Developing and maintaining methodologies and policies for liquidity and market derivative modelling
Delivering real impact to the product through rigorous data-driven solutions
Building, enhancing, and maintaining the core risk engine, including margin models, leverage frameworks, and liquidation logic
Developing and calibrating risk models across isolated/cross margin, partial/full liquidation, bankruptcy pricing, and future portfolio margining capabilities
Collaborating with Engineering to deploy risk methodologies into production systems while iteratively improving models based on market conditions
Automating advanced analytic workflows, including P&L attribution, daily risk reporting, short-term investment performance, and cash flow analysis
Preparing documentation for compliance, and presenting risk insights, exposures, and recommendations to senior leadership


What You'll Need


A degree in mathematics, statistics, financial engineering, machine learning, or computer science
3+ years of experience in machine learning, financial engineering, or similar roles within liquidity or market derivatives
Knowledge of margin trading mechanics, derivatives pricing models, and liquidation/liquidity risk management
Expertise in building and validating risk and margin models (VaR, Expected Shortfall, SPAN, CCP-style IM/VM, stress tests, scenario simulations)
Proficiency in quantitative modelling and time-series methods (GARCH, ARIMA, stochastic calculus), with advanced Python and SQL skills for large-scale data analysis
Familiarity with high-frequency datasets, and the ability to work well in fast-paced risk environments


Nice to have


Experience at a major financial institution, asset manager, or liquidity provider, or within a treasury or risk department (FTP, ALM, liquidity, IRRB, etc.)
Exposure to market-making workflows and risks (inventory management, P&L drivers, spread optimisation, and internalisation strategies)
Familiarity with regulatory and institutional risk frameworks (Basel III/IV, FRTB, SA-CCR, CCP margin methodologies)


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.


Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d) im Reportingbereich
Description:
Ihre Rolle in unserem Team

Als Data Scientist (m/w/d) treiben Sie die datengetriebene Entscheidungsfindung in unserem Unternehmen voran. Sie konzipieren und entwickeln neue Datenprodukte für unseren Servicebereich, insbesondere für ein gruppenweites Reporting. Perspektivisch unterstützen Sie zudem die Organisationsentwicklung durch die Einführung und Nutzung von Process-Mining-Tools zur Prozessanalyse und -optimierung. Darüber hinaus verantworten Sie weitere datenbezogene Entwicklungsinitiativen und liefern mit Ihren Analysen wertvolle Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Ihre Arbeit stärkt eine Kultur des Datendenkens und macht datengesteuerte Services umsetzbar, wodurch Sie einen direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des gesamten Unternehmens haben.

Verantwortlichkeiten



Konzeption und Entwicklung von Datenmodellen auf Basis von SAP Datasphere
Erstellung von Analyse-Dashboards und Reports mit definierten KPIs in der SAP Analytics Cloud sowie Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen
Umsetzung, Dokumentation und Einführung der entwickelten Datenmodelle
Steuerung datengetriebener Projekte und Initiativen als Projekt- oder Programmmanager:in
Aufbau und Einführung eines Process-Mining-Tools für Root-Cause-Analysen



Ihr Profil



Sie haben abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
Sie begeistern sich für Daten, Analysen und Prozesse und besitzen ein ausgeprägtes konzeptionelles Denkvermögen
Sie verfügen über starke technische Fähigkeiten und können komplexe Geschäftsprobleme strukturiert lösen
Sie verstehen den geschäftlichen Kontext und besitzen die Fähigkeit den möglichen Einsatz von Datenanalysen zur Verbesserung von Abläufen zu erkennen
Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse von Methoden und Modellen der Datenanalyse
Sie fühlen sich sicher im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen und haben Erfahrung mit Datenbanken sowie Datenvisualisierungstools
Sie besitzen gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL sowie Erfahrung mit SAP; Kenntnisse in Python sind von Vorteil
Sie sind in der Lage die Erkenntnisse Ihrer Arbeit verständlich, adressatengerecht und überzeugend gegenüber den Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren



Ihre Vorteile



Sie arbeiten in einem internationalen, kollaborativen und angenehmen Arbeitsumfeld
Sinnvolle und herausfordernde Aufgaben in einer schnell wachsenden Branche
Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur weiteren Entwicklung
Ein Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – vertrauliche Beratung und Unterstützung bei gesundheitlichen, beruflichen und persönlichen Herausforderungen
Attraktives Vergütungspaket
Modernes Büro, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zu Remote Work

Title: (Senior) Data Scientist
HTML:
Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist that develops and produces sustainable, safe and convenient solutions for automotive manufacturers as well as industrial and end customers worldwide. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

Job Description

In Digital Solutions, we drive innovation for connected mobility and deliver cutting-edge digital products to our global fleet customers. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be at the forefront of transforming data into intelligent, scalable solutions.

You will design, develop, and deploy advanced data science models that solve complex business challenges and deliver measurable impact. Working closely with Data Engineers, MLOps Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will turn raw data into actionable insights and production-ready solutions that power smarter, safer, and more efficient mobility worldwide.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead technical development projects, including scope definition, concept design, and proof-of-concept, and report progress to stakeholders;
  • Design and develop data science models to solve complex customer problems and conduct proof-of-concepts for feasibility and scalability;
  • Build and deploy validated models into production-ready solutions, ensuring robustness, maintainability, and lifecycle management;
  • Engage with business stakeholders to understand requirements, facilitate workshops, and translate technical topics into clear, non-technical language;
  • Collaborate with MLOps Engineer and Data Engineers to realize data-driven projects;
  • Mentor junior Data Scientists, review work, and organize knowledge-sharing sessions to foster best practices.

Qualifications

  • Academic degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field;
  • > 4 years of experience as a Data Scientist;
  • Reliable team player with structured self-organized workstyle;
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL;
  • Expertise in machine learning and AI (supervised, unsupervised, deep learning, time-series);
  • Proficiency in cloud and big data platforms;
  • Advanced skills in exploratory data analysis and dashboarding;
  • Hands-on experience with data engineering tools (e.g., Airflow);
  • Solid understanding of MLOps and model deployment practices;
  • Experience with Agile project management methods (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Fluent English language skills (written and spoken).

Additional Information

Our offer:

  • Integration in a challenging and international work environment;
  • Flexible working model;
  • Agile and collaborative working style;
  • Continuous opportunities for the promotion of talent and training.

Title: Analista de Dados (M/F)
HTML:
A GreenVenture é uma empresa privada de investimento e gestão de ativos especializada na identificação, aquisição, desenvolvimento e implementação de projetos de energia renovável.


Acreditamos no poder da ação coletiva e da inovação para criar um futuro sustentável. Procuramos reforçar a nossa estrutura com um Analista de dados (m/f).


Missão:

Para suportar o crescimento das nossas áreas de produção e comercialização de energia, procuramos profissional para desenvolvimento de modelos matemáticos aplicados a mercados de eletricidade;


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de modelos de previsão multi-variável e multi-horizonte (produção solar e eólica, consumo, preço, desvios);
  • Desenvolver dashboards de monitorização de desempenho e relatórios analíticos (KPIs de precisão, eficiência e retorno);
  • Implementar rotinas de data cleaning, atualização automática de datasets e version control de modelos;
  • Sistemas de decisão em tempo real para mercados grossistas e mercados de serviços de sistema;
  • Colaborar com a equipa técnica e de gestão na interpretação dos resultados preditivos e na sua integração nas decisões de trading;
  • Validação, monitorização e backtesting de modelos em ambiente operacional;
  • Colaboração com a equipa de operação na definição de requisitos e avaliação de resultados.


Perfil:

  • Formação superior em Matemática (pura ou aplicada), Física ou Engenharia Física. Áreas afins com sólida base quantitativa (Estatística, Data Science) poderão ser consideradas;
  • Domínio sólido de Python (numpy, pandas); familiaridade com bibliotecas de ML e otimização (scikit-learn, PyTorch, Pyomo, OR-Tools) constitui uma mais-valia;
  • Conforto com séries temporais, modelação probabilística, otimização sob restrições e teoria da decisão;
  • Capacidade de trabalho com dados incompletos, multi-fonte e em diferentes granularidades temporais;
  • Pensamento crítico e rigor analítico.


Oferta:

  • Integração numa empresa sólida e em crescimento;
  • Equipa com estrutura profissional e dinâmica;
  • Remuneração em função da experiência demonstrada.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
About Us 🚀

Hostelworld is the world's leading Social Travel platform - a social network-powered OTA on a mission to help travellers find their people and create unforgettable moments together. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, we're a team of around 270 people serving hostel partners across more than 180 countries.

Since launching our social network in 2022, we've welcomed over 3.4 million social members who aren't just booking trips, they're messaging, finding events, meeting up and becoming powerful brand advocates. This community generates a rich proprietary dataset of 16 million+ chat messages and 17 million bookings, powering AI-driven personalisation and network effects that no generalist OTA can replicate.

We are not just another OTA - we created an entirely new category – Social Travel. If you want to shape the future of travel by putting people and shared experiences at the heart of it, you'll fit right in here - Learn more about our Team!

OUR CULTURE

At Hostelworld, our culture is a direct reflection of our customers: adventurous, curious, and social. We have a shared love of travel that fuels our work and connects us on a deeper level. It’s a fast-paced environment that blends the agility and "scrappy" resourcefulness of a start-up with the experience and ambition of a global, publicly listed company.

We are a team of pragmatic optimists who are data-obsessed and results-driven. We value a ‘test and learn’ mindset, encouraging experimentation and empowering our teams to take calculated risks. We believe in doing the right thing—for our customers, our partners, and each other. We foster a supportive and collaborative atmosphere where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and where every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact on our journey. We embrace the journey, not just the destination, and we seek leaders who will thrive in a dynamic environment and inspire their teams to do the same.

LOCATION🌍

This role is based in Portugal. We have an office hub in Porto available for those who prefer a hybrid model where you can spend time with colleagues in-person. You will need to be able to commute to our office hub as required from time to time.

What The Role Looks Like 🆕

Build production ML and LLM systems that improve Hostelworld discovery, relevance and efficiency. This role focuses on MCP servers, agent-facing tools, LLM applications, model evaluation, and adapting open-source or commercial models to improve accuracy, latency and cost.

What You'll Do 👩‍💻


Translate traveller, hostel and business problems into ML/LLM solutions across search, ranking, destination discovery, property Q&A, social matching and content understanding.
Design, build and operate MCP servers and agent-facing APIs that expose Hostelworld capabilities safely to LLMs and external agent ecosystems.
Build LLM applications using RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool/function calling, structured outputs, moderation and product logic.
Improve Hostelworld-specific accuracy through benchmarks, error analysis, prompt/version control, fine-tuning, distillation, synthetic data and model selection.
Evaluate and adapt open-source or commercial models where they improve quality, latency, vendor flexibility or inference cost.
Own productionisation end to end: data pipelines, embeddings/features, model serving, APIs, monitoring, alerting, documentation and support.
Work with AI Gateway, data platform and engineering teams on model routing, caching, rate limits, cost observability, guardrails and provider abstraction.
Define hypotheses, run experiments and communicate technical, product and commercial impact to Product, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing and senior stakeholders.


KEY FOCUS AREA


MCP and agent visibility: hostel search, property Q&A, city/social context, deep links and logging to identify blind spots in AI-mediated travel discovery.
Hostelworld-specific LLM quality: evaluation datasets using inventory, reviews, attributes, social signals, booking context and destination data.
Cost and latency optimisation: model routing, caching, smaller models, batching, quantisation, distillation and provider selection.
Reusable infrastructure: evaluation harnesses, deployment patterns, libraries and templates for a small high-expertise ML team.


What We’re Looking For 👀

MUST HAVE


Strong Python and SQL, with modular design, testing, CI/CD, code review, documentation and operational ownership.
Production ML experience, ideally in search, ranking, recommendations, personalisation, marketplaces, travel, ecommerce or consumer products.
Practical LLM engineering: RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompt management and monitoring.
Experience building ML/LLM services.
MCP servers, agentic workflows, LangGraph/LangChain/LlamaIndex or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
Strong evaluation mindset: offline benchmarks, relevance evaluation, A/B testing, error analysis, factuality/safety checks, latency and cost measurement.
Ability to reason about model trade-offs: frontier vs small model, fine-tuned vs prompted, traditional ML vs rules, and quality vs latency vs cost.
Working knowledge of cloud/data/ML infrastructure such as GCP, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Kubernetes preferred; Redis, Postgres, MongoDB/vector stores or similar also applicable.
Clear communication with engineers, product managers and senior stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Fine-tuning, distillation, quantisation or serving open-source models.
Agentic experience.
Multilingual travel content, review summarisation, moderation, social graphs, recommendation systems or marketplace ranking.
Synthetic data or prompt-set generation for AI visibility, competitor benchmarking or agent-behaviour measurement.


SUCCESS PROFILE


First 90 days: understands Hostelworld ranking, social travel, Q&A, AI Gateway and MCP priorities; ships or materially improves one LLM/MCP component or evaluation framework.
Six months: owns a measurable workstream improving LLM answer quality, agent discoverability, latency or cost with monitoring and product/business impact.

Title: GenAI Analyst
Description:
About AUTOMAISE

AUTOMAISE is based in Braga, Portugal and is developing an Automated Machine Learning platform to build productivity solutions for Operations and Customer Care. We offer a no-code/low-code platform that enables brands to automate complex processes within incredibly short timeframes, helping organizations supercharge digital transformation strategies.

Job Overview:

We're looking for a Generative AI Analyst with a focus on enhancing our chatbot and voicebot solutions. This role is ideal for someone passionate about improving AI interactions and making digital communication feel more human. You'll work on refining the conversational abilities of our AI by testing, iterating, and optimizing prompts and knowledge bases.

What you’ll do:


Iteratively fine-tune GenAI prompts and parameters and adjust knowledge bases to enhance conversation quality and user experience.
Perform quality analysis of chatbot interaction logs, prompts, enabling continuous improvement of conversational accuracy and user experience.
Apply basic Python skills for data analysis and solutions testing.
Collaborate with the AI team to implement changes that improve bot performance and customer satisfaction.
Conduct thorough testing of our chatbot and voicebot solutions to identify areas for improvement.
Analyze user feedback and interaction data to guide your optimization efforts.
Ensure our bots' language capabilities are inclusive, accurate, and culturally relevant, with particular emphasis on Portuguese and English.


Minimum Requirements

What we’re looking for:


2 years minimum of experience in a data analyst role and an academic degree in a Computer Science field, Mathematics or Statistics.
Strong analytical skills, with a keen eye for detail and a creative problem-solving approach.
Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.) and their strengths/limitations.
Ability to design, test, and iterate prompts systematically.
Understanding of prompt engineering principles (e.g., role prompting, chain-of-thought structuring, few-shot examples, and evaluation strategies).
Basic knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis.
Exposure to vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively across different departments.
Passion for AI and a user-centric approach to technology development.
Basic understanding of APIs is a plus, but not required.
Experience with chatbot or voicebot platforms is a plus, but not required.
Excellent command of Portuguese and English.


What you’ll get from us:


Competitive Salary: Attractive compensation based on your experience and role.
Generous Time Off: Enjoy 22 days of paid annual leave plus 5 extra days.
Flexible Work Options: Hybrid work regime.
Performance Bonuses: Earn bonuses based on your achievements.
Health Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
Career Growth: Opportunities for personal and professional development.
Continuous Learning: Access to training programs to enhance your skills.
Supportive Team: Join a dynamic, agile, and expanding team.
Growth Opportunities: Thrive in a growing company with a strong career path.
Positive Environment: Enjoy a collaborative and open work culture.
Unique Office Space: Work in an inspiring office at Braga’s city center.
Work-Life Balance: Embrace a balanced work-life with flexibility and support.
Fun Perks: Engage in company events, treats, and team-building activities.


Ready to Take the Next Step? APPLY NOW!

We are excited to hear everything about you and why you think this role is a fit for you. Please reach out with your LinkedIn profile/CV, and don’t hesitate to contact us with any questions at jobs@automaise.com

Title: Distributed Cloud | AI/Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
At Devoteam, we believe that technology with strong human values can actively drive change for the better. Discover how Tech for People unlocks the future, creating a positive impact on the people and the world around us. We are a global leading player in Digital Transformation for leading organisations across EMEA, with a revenue of €1B. We believe in transforming technology to create value for our clients, partners and employees in a world where technology is developed for people. We are proud of the culture we have built together. We are proud of our people at the service of technology. We are proud of our diverse environment. Because we are #TechforPeople. Join our multidisciplinary team of Cloud experts, Designers, Business consultants, Security experts, Engineers, Developers and other extraordinary talents, spread across more than 20 EMEA countries. Become one of our +10.000 tech and business leaders on cloud, data and cyber security. Let’s fuse creativity with technology together and build innovative solutions that actively change things for the better.

Job Description

We are seeking a versatile and passionate AI / Machine Learning Engineer to join our data science and engineering team. You will be instrumental in bridging the gap between data science research and production-ready applications, building scalable machine learning systems that drive business value. This role requires a strong balance of software engineering principles and ML expertise.

Key Responsibilities


Design, develop, and implement end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines for training, testing, and deployment of predictive models.
Work closely with Data Scientists to translate prototypes and models into scalable, production-grade code (MLOps).
Develop robust, efficient, and well-documented code primarily using Python and relevant ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
Implement monitoring and alerting solutions for models in production to track performance, detect drift, and ensure reliability.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure efficient data preparation, feature engineering, and access to necessary data infrastructure.
Stay current with the latest advancements in AI, ML techniques, and scalable infrastructure.



Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in a Machine Learning Engineer, AI Developer, or similar role.
Strong expertise in Python and object-oriented programming, with a focus on code quality and best practices.
Mandatory practical experience with major Machine Learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and libraries (e.g., scikit-learn).
Solid understanding of MLOps principles and the tools required for model deployment, versioning, and lifecycle management (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar).
Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large datasets and data warehousing concepts.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively.
Experience working with Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for model deployment, compute, and storage (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML Services).
Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) for building reproducible and scalable ML environments.
Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark).
Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
Very good level of English, both spoken and written, for effective communication with international teams;



Additional Information

The Devoteam Group works for equal opportunities, promoting its employees based on merit and actively fights against all forms of discrimination. We are convinced that diversity contributes to the creativity, dynamism and excellence of our organization. All of our vacancies are open to people with disabilities.

Founded in 2006 with the mission "To Challenge Complexity", Closer Consulting is a Data Science company specializing in Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence.

Description:
Analista IA (M/F)




Sobre a Palmtop

Grupo com mais de 23 anos de experiência no mercado empresarial e institucional, a Palmtop disponibiliza uma oferta integrada de soluções nas áreas de consultoria e integração de sistemas, cibersegurança, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento web.

Para reforçar a nossa equipa e apoiar o crescimento dos projetos atuais e futuros, procuramos um(a) Analista de IA que combine competências técnicas sólidas com uma forte orientação para o trabalho em equipa e para o cliente.

Porque poderás gostar de trabalhar connosco

Procuramos pessoas que valorizem um ambiente onde:
O desempenho é reconhecido através de uma remuneração competitiva, mas também pela valorização das pessoas e das suas contribuições.
A colaboração é um verdadeiro fator de sucesso: cada pessoa conta, mas juntos alcançamos mais.
Existe partilha de conhecimento, entreajuda e evolução contínua.
A exigência anda de mãos dadas com o respeito e o equilíbrio.
A conciliação entre vida profissional e pessoal é considerada essencial.
As ideias são ouvidas, valorizadas e colocadas em prática num ambiente próximo e informal.
Se te identificas com estes princípios, gostaríamos de te conhecer.

 

O que procuramos

Para que este desafio faça sentido para ambas as partes, procuramos candidatos que reúnam os seguintes requisitos:




Competências Técnicas

12º ano (preferencialmente técnico-profissional) ou superior (muito valorizado)
Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de projetos relacionados com IA (valorizado)
Conhecimento em Machine Learning, Data Science e entendimento de IA Generativa. (obrigatório)
Conhecimento em Python e conceitos de automação (valorizado)
Conhecimento de governança em IA e compliance em ambientes empresariais (valorizado)
Bons conhecimentos de inglês, escrito e falado

 

Competências Pessoais

Valorizamos tanto as competências técnicas como a forma de estar e trabalhar:

Integridade, responsabilidade e forte orientação para o cliente.
Interesse genuíno por tecnologia e aprendizagem contínua.
Capacidade de análise, resolução e prevenção de problemas.
Organização, autonomia, espírito crítico e sentido de responsabilidade.
Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipa.
Carta de condução.

 

O que vais fazer

Vais colaborar com as várias áreas da empresa e colegas que vão colaborar contigo
Participar em projetos de implementação, melhoria e evolução tecnológica.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos internos e da qualidade do serviço prestado.




O que oferecemos

Integração numa empresa sólida e em crescimento.
Contacto com tecnologias diversificadas e projetos desafiantes.
Ambiente colaborativo, próximo e orientado para a partilha de conhecimento.
Oportunidades reais de evolução profissional e técnica.
Pacote remuneratório ajustado à experiência e desempenho.




Localização

Leça da Palmeira, Matosinhos

 

Se acreditas que tens o perfil certo e procuras um desafio onde possas crescer profissionalmente e gerar impacto real nos clientes, envia-nos a tua candidatura para o e-mail candidaturas@palmtop.pt com o assunto “Candidatura PALMTOP BS 3/2026”

Title: Senior Finance Data Scientist
Description:
Join Our Mission to Improve Lives Worldwide

At Bial, our purpose is clear: to be partners in life, improving people’s lives through innovation and science.




Integrated into Bial’s Finance Operations Department, you will drive finance transformation by developing data-driven solutions, automating processes, and delivering insights that support performance, governance, and growth.







The Impact You’ll Make

Develop and implement advanced analytics, predictive models, and AI-driven solutions to support financial planning, forecasting, risk management, and business performance
Analyse complex financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights for decision-making
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting models, and data visualisation tools to enhance business visibility and performance monitoring
Generate data-driven insights to support key Finance processes, including accounting, controlling, treasury, tax, budgeting, and forecasting
Drive the automation and optimisation of finance processes through digital technologies, improving efficiency, scalability, and operational effectiveness
Collaborate with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to design, implement, and continuously improve data solutions, ERP capabilities, and finance-related systems
Support finance transformation and process standardisation initiatives across functions and geographical locations
Leverage strong knowledge of finance processes to identify improvement opportunities, support business requirements, and ensure alignment between analytical solutions and operational needs
Ensure data quality, integrity, governance, and compliance by developing robust, scalable, and business-oriented data models and reporting structures
Ensure effective risk and control oversight by leveraging automation, analytics, and finance compliance-focused processes







What You’ll Bring

Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance or a related field
5-8 years of experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Digital Transformation roles
Experience working with financial data, finance processes, or finance-related business environments is highly valued
Proven business acumen with a track record of Finance Global Process Ownership (GPO), including end-to-end finance processes definition, global standardization, and continuous improvement across complex enterprise environments
Experience delivering automation and analytics projects within corporate environments
Experience with Power BI or similar data visualisation tools
Experience with process automation solutions (Power Automate, RPA tools, or similar)
Knowledge of ERP systems
Advanced data modelling and statistical analysis capabilities
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
Fluent in English

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
About Us

Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.

In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.

With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.

Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

Role Overview

As an Associate Analytics Engineer II, you will take increased ownership in building and maintaining analytics‑ready data models that support reporting, dashboards, and business decision‑making. This role builds on foundational analytics engineering skills and focuses on independent delivery, data quality, and consistent application of best practices using dbt, SQL, and Snowflake.

You will work closely with Senior Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and business stakeholders to transform raw data into clean, tested, and well‑documented datasets. Compared to the AAE role, this position requires less day‑to‑day guidance and greater accountability for the quality and reliability of delivered models.

The AAE II is expected to be a reliable individual contributor, capable of owning well‑scoped analytics transformations end‑to‑end while continuing to grow toward senior‑level responsibilities.

What You Will Do

Design & Develop Analytics Models


Independently develop Bronze → Silver dbt models following established standards.
Contribute to Gold‑layer models and analytics outputs under guidance.
Apply dimensional modeling concepts (facts, dimensions) to support analytics and BI use cases.


Data Transformation & dbt Development


Use dbt to build, test, and document analytics models.
Refactor existing models to improve clarity, performance, or consistency.
Apply reusable patterns and macros where appropriate.


Data Quality & Testing


Implement appropriate dbt tests (e.g. not null, uniqueness, accepted values) for all owned models.
Validate data outputs against business logic and expected behaviour.
Identify potential data quality issues early and work with peers to resolve them.


Performance & Reliability


Be mindful of model performance and warehouse costs.
Apply basic optimisation techniques (e.g. filtering, incremental models) with guidance.
Monitor model runs and respond to failures or anomalies.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Support


Work closely with analysts to understand reporting and data requirements.
Support analytics use cases by ensuring data is well‑structured and clearly defined.
Communicate progress, risks, and blockers proactively.


Documentation & Knowledge Sharing


Own documentation for delivered models and columns using dbt.
Write clear, business‑friendly definitions aligned with shared terminology.
Contribute to shared team documentation, standards, or playbooks.


Continuous Improvement


Suggest improvements to existing models, tests, or workflows.
Learn and apply analytics engineering best practices.
Begin supporting junior engineers through knowledge sharing or informal guidance.


Who You Are


3–6 years of experience in analytics engineering, analytics, or a closely related role
Strong SQL skills and experience working with analytics datasets
Practical experience using dbt for transformations, tests, and documentation
Experience working with a modern data warehouse (e.g. Snowflake)
Familiarity with BI and analytics consumption patterns


Nice to Have


Exposure to semantic layers or shared metrics
Experience supporting Power BI or similar BI tools
Familiarity with Git‑based workflows and CI checks
Understanding of incremental modeling and performance tuning basics


What Success Looks Like


Independently delivers consistent, high‑quality Silver‑layer models
Applies testing and documentation without prompting
Requires limited review cycles for standard work
Demonstrates growing confidence in modeling decisions
Is viewed as a dependable contributor by analysts and peers


Why Planet

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce. We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

At b.telligent, you will work on challenging customer projects across different industries, collaborate closely with experienced data and analytics specialists, and help organisations build modern, data-driven solutions.

In this role, you will closely work with and be an integral part of our partner company emnos for which you will deliver the services described here within.

emnos is part of the b.telligent network

emnos is a global leading provider of an Al-based Retail Analytics B2B platform for retailers and their suppliers. The platform focuses on secure and efficient exchange of information and analysis between retailers and their suppliers, creating new business opportunities and revenue streams.

Your responsibilities


Design, develop and maintain reliable ETL and ELT pipelines using Python, SQL and Airflow or Google Cloud Composer
Build and optimise scalable data models in Google BigQuery
Apply data-modelling concepts such as star schemas, snowflake schemas and dimensional modelling
Develop data transformations and analytics-ready datasets for downstream consumption
Translate complex data structures into intuitive semantic layers and visualisations
Create dashboards and reports with Looker, Yellowfin or comparable BI tools
Work closely with customers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and define relevant KPIs
Turn business requirements into practical analytics solutions and actionable insights
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data architectures, engineering standards and best practices
Use Databricks and Apache Spark where appropriate for advanced data processing and lakehouse scenarios
Document technical solutions, data models and operational processes


Your profile


Professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence or a comparable role
Strong knowledge of Python and advanced SQL skills
Practical experience developing ETL and ELT pipelines
Experience with Apache Airflow or Google Cloud Composer
Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery and modern data-warehousing concepts
Knowledge of data modelling, including star and snowflake schemas
Experience with Looker, Yellowfin or another enterprise BI and visualisation tool
Familiarity with dbt or similar transformation frameworks is an advantage
Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark or lakehouse architectures is a plus
A structured, analytical and solution-oriented approach
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
Fluent English and Portuguese; German is an advantage
Enjoyment of working with customers and collaborating across technical and business teams


What to expect


A full-time position based in Porto, Portugal
A hybrid working model with office collaboration and home-office flexibility
Challenging customer projects across different industries
The opportunity to help shape modern data platforms and analytics solutions
Collaboration with experienced data, analytics and cloud specialists
Support for professional development and relevant certifications
Opportunities to attend conferences and community events
A collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous learning


Ready to turn data into impact?

Do you want to build modern data platforms, create meaningful analytics solutions and help customers make better decisions with data? Join b.telligent in Porto as our next Data & Analytics Engineer.

Apply now and become part of a collaborative team that combines data engineering, analytics and business expertise to create real value. We look forward to meeting you!

Title: Analista de preços
Description:
Referência centenária no setor automóvel e da mobilidade, o Grupo JAP representa 15 marcas automóveis, em mais de 60 pontos de venda e reparação CARBY, detém a MATRIZAUTO (maior megastore de viaturas seminovas e usadas do país) e o master franchise da rent a car SIXT em Portugal.

Nacionalmente é, também, uma referência no mercado das máquinas agrícolas e industriais e de movimentação de cargas, com o Entreposto Máquinas, representante oficial de mais de 10 marcas do setor.

Em África, o Grupo está presente em Angola, Quénia, Uganda e Tanzânia, onde é uma força em crescimento no mercado dos veículos pesados (MAN) e das máquinas agrícolas e industriais. Já em Moçambique, com a marca Entreposto, é uma referência de soluções de mobilidade, com viaturas ligeiras e pesadas, máquinas agrícolas e industriais e outros serviços adjacentes.

Fazer parte do universo JAP é um compromisso com a evolução e a diversidade de mercados, clientes, geografias, pessoas e equipas.

Se procura um desafio profissional aliciante, este projeto é para si!




Responsabilidades:

- Analisar dados históricos de vendas, para identificar padrões e tendências.

- Monitorizar preços de mercado em diferentes canais e localizações.

- Construir, manter e atualizar modelos de pricing dinâmico que suportem decisões diárias de revenue management.

- Desenvolver e aplicar modelos preditivos com machine learning (procura, sazonalidade, impacto de promoções).

- Apoiar a equipa de gestão de frota e operações na definição de estratégias de alocação e otimização de recursos.

- Criar dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão da gestão.

- Contribuir para a definição de políticas comerciais e campanhas promocionais baseadas em análises de rentabilidade.




Perfil:

- Formação superior em Engenharia e Gestão Industrial.

- Conhecimentos de Excel avançado e SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.

- Conhecimentos em linguagens de programação (Python ou R) aplicados a análise de dados, estatística e machine learning são valorizados.

- Conhecimentos de ferramentas de visualização de dados, Power BI, Looker ou similar.

- Conhecimentos de inglês.




Oferecemos:

- Integração num Grupo sólido e credível, tendo em curso a implementação de vários projetos de crescimento;

- Formação e possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal;

- Oportunidade real de progressão de carreira, de acordo com o desempenho e as competências demonstradas;

- Boas condições de trabalho e regalias sociais em vigor na empresa (Seguro de Saúde e Seguro de Vida).

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
About Us 🚀

Hostelworld is the world's leading Social Travel platform - a social network-powered OTA on a mission to help travellers find their people and create unforgettable moments together. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, we're a team of around 270 people serving hostel partners across more than 180 countries.

Since launching our social network in 2022, we've welcomed over 3.4 million social members who aren't just booking trips, they're messaging, finding events, meeting up and becoming powerful brand advocates. This community generates a rich proprietary dataset of 16 million+ chat messages and 17 million bookings, powering AI-driven personalisation and network effects that no generalist OTA can replicate.

We are not just another OTA - we created an entirely new category – Social Travel. If you want to shape the future of travel by putting people and shared experiences at the heart of it, you'll fit right in here - Learn more about our Team!

OUR CULTURE

At Hostelworld, our culture is a direct reflection of our customers: adventurous, curious, and social. We have a shared love of travel that fuels our work and connects us on a deeper level. It’s a fast-paced environment that blends the agility and "scrappy" resourcefulness of a start-up with the experience and ambition of a global, publicly listed company.

We are a team of pragmatic optimists who are data-obsessed and results-driven. We value a ‘test and learn’ mindset, encouraging experimentation and empowering our teams to take calculated risks. We believe in doing the right thing—for our customers, our partners, and each other. We foster a supportive and collaborative atmosphere where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and where every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact on our journey. We embrace the journey, not just the destination, and we seek leaders who will thrive in a dynamic environment and inspire their teams to do the same.

LOCATION🌍

This role is based in Portugal. We have an office hub in Porto available for those who prefer a hybrid model where you can spend time with colleagues in-person. You will need to be able to commute to our office hub as required from time to time.

What The Role Looks Like 🆕

Build production ML and LLM systems that improve Hostelworld discovery, relevance and efficiency. This role focuses on MCP servers, agent-facing tools, LLM applications, model evaluation, and adapting open-source or commercial models to improve accuracy, latency and cost.

What You'll Do 👩‍💻


Translate traveller, hostel and business problems into ML/LLM solutions across search, ranking, destination discovery, property Q&A, social matching and content understanding.
Design, build and operate MCP servers and agent-facing APIs that expose Hostelworld capabilities safely to LLMs and external agent ecosystems.
Build LLM applications using RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool/function calling, structured outputs, moderation and product logic.
Improve Hostelworld-specific accuracy through benchmarks, error analysis, prompt/version control, fine-tuning, distillation, synthetic data and model selection.
Evaluate and adapt open-source or commercial models where they improve quality, latency, vendor flexibility or inference cost.
Own productionisation end to end: data pipelines, embeddings/features, model serving, APIs, monitoring, alerting, documentation and support.
Work with AI Gateway, data platform and engineering teams on model routing, caching, rate limits, cost observability, guardrails and provider abstraction.
Define hypotheses, run experiments and communicate technical, product and commercial impact to Product, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing and senior stakeholders.


KEY FOCUS AREA


MCP and agent visibility: hostel search, property Q&A, city/social context, deep links and logging to identify blind spots in AI-mediated travel discovery.
Hostelworld-specific LLM quality: evaluation datasets using inventory, reviews, attributes, social signals, booking context and destination data.
Cost and latency optimisation: model routing, caching, smaller models, batching, quantisation, distillation and provider selection.
Reusable infrastructure: evaluation harnesses, deployment patterns, libraries and templates for a small high-expertise ML team.


What We’re Looking For 👀

MUST HAVE


Strong Python and SQL, with modular design, testing, CI/CD, code review, documentation and operational ownership.
Production ML experience, ideally in search, ranking, recommendations, personalisation, marketplaces, travel, ecommerce or consumer products.
Practical LLM engineering: RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompt management and monitoring.
Experience building ML/LLM services.
MCP servers, agentic workflows, LangGraph/LangChain/LlamaIndex or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
Strong evaluation mindset: offline benchmarks, relevance evaluation, A/B testing, error analysis, factuality/safety checks, latency and cost measurement.
Ability to reason about model trade-offs: frontier vs small model, fine-tuned vs prompted, traditional ML vs rules, and quality vs latency vs cost.
Working knowledge of cloud/data/ML infrastructure such as GCP, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Kubernetes preferred; Redis, Postgres, MongoDB/vector stores or similar also applicable.
Clear communication with engineers, product managers and senior stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Fine-tuning, distillation, quantisation or serving open-source models.
Agentic experience.
Multilingual travel content, review summarisation, moderation, social graphs, recommendation systems or marketplace ranking.
Synthetic data or prompt-set generation for AI visibility, competitor benchmarking or agent-behaviour measurement.


SUCCESS PROFILE


First 90 days: understands Hostelworld ranking, social travel, Q&A, AI Gateway and MCP priorities; ships or materially improves one LLM/MCP component or evaluation framework.
Six months: owns a measurable workstream improving LLM answer quality, agent discoverability, latency or cost with monitoring and product/business impact.
Long term: becomes a go-to technical owner for Hostelworld’s agentic AI and LLM infrastructure.

Title: Data Engineer
HTML:
As part of our IT team and a member of our Business Intelligence unit, you will play a pivotal role in developing the data maturity of our business and establishing a culture of data-driven commercial decision making across the organisation.


Reporting to the Commercial Finance Manager in the UK, you will build a holistic view of the context behind and commercial importance of our new and existing data solutions, and your role will focus on ensuring the underlying data is neatly stored, accurate, reliable, and readily available in the appropriate format for external analysis and reporting.


As the steward of our new data warehouse, you will also be the main source of knowledge for all data-related queries, and you will be responsible for troubleshooting any issues with our existing datasets.


There may also be opportunities to develop your skills through relevant training or professional certification where these align with your career ambitions and support business objectives.


From day 1, you will therefore be a highly-valued, core enabler of the continued growth of our business.


Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities in this role will include:

  • Reporting to the Commercial Finance Manager and attending weekly meetings with the IT team and Business Intelligence unit, providing progress updates on your live projects and helping to shape the roadmap for future projects;
  • Managing our data warehouse in BigQuery, ensuring data is stored methodically and any data challenges or inconsistencies are addressed promptly;
  • Extracting, transforming, and loading data from our software stack, including pre-packaged software and bespoke in-house platforms, into BigQuery – both for our core business and any new businesses that we acquire;
  • Writing and maintaining Python-based ETL connectors to extract data from APIs (e.g. HubSpot, Sage HR) and relational databases (e.g. MySQL) into BigQuery;
  • Building and maintaining data transformation models in dbt, including testing and documentation, to ensure trusted, analytics-ready datasets;
  • Orchestrating and monitoring ETL / transformation jobs using Dagster, including troubleshooting pipeline failures and schema drift;
  • Using Git for version control and collaborating on changes to the ETL codebase and dbt project;
  • Managing a portfolio of data visualisation solutions in Power BI, and continuously updating user guides to help stakeholders navigate these solutions effectively;
  • Developing new data visualisation solutions in Power BI at the request of various departments, liaising with key stakeholders to understand their specifications and reacting to changing priorities in line with business needs;
  • Proactively communicating with your IT colleagues to discuss any technical or system-related considerations underpinning your projects.


Qualifications & Experience

The candidate must meet the following essential criteria:

  • Advanced proficiency in interpreting and writing SQL;
  • Prior experience of working with a data warehouse, ideally BigQuery;
  • Prior experience of working with Power BI or an equivalent data visualisation platform (e.g. Tableau) for developing new dashboards;
  • Prior experience with an ETL tool and managing ETL pipelines;
  • Proficiency in Python for building and maintaining data extraction and transformation scripts;
  • Prior experience with dbt or a similar data modelling / transformation tool;
  • Prior experience with a workflow orchestration tool (e.g. Dagster, Airflow);
  • Proficiency with Git or another version control system.


It would also be desirable for the candidate to meet some or all of the following:

  • Prior experience in managing a portfolio of data products / solutions;
  • Prior experience of working with financial data;
  • Prior experience of working in a multi-geography organisation with cross-border colleagues;
  • Prior experience working with cloud platforms (e.g. GCP), including secret / credential management;
  • Prior experience with Linux and bash scripting for managing data infrastructure.


Personal attributes/characteristics:

The ideal candidate for this role must demonstrate the following:

  • Advanced proficiency in English reading and writing;
  • Strong organisation skills, and able to manage and progress multiple live projects at once;
  • Flexible and agile, and able to seamlessly re-balance priorities in line with business needs;
  • Confident, proactive and vocal in challenging data integrity / assumptions; Strong level of initiative in creating inventive, time-saving solutions that will achieve the same desired output;
  • Good level of commercial acumen and business literacy, or a keen desire to build on this knowledge.

A nossa paixão coloca-nos no lugar certo.

A CodeWin nasceu da fusão de duas empresas líderes no setor tecnológico: Decode e Sowin. Unimos a nossa paixão, os nossos talentos, conhecimentos e experiências para levar até às nossas pessoas e parceiros as melhores soluções em transformação digital e consultoria. A nossa expertise assenta em Software Development, ERP, CRM, Data Strategy e Digital Experiences.

Queremos contribuir para um mundo melhor e sabemos que isso só é possível equilibrando a evolução tecnológica com o bem-estar das empresas, pessoas e sociedade. Para isso, precisamos das pessoas certas. Para isso, precisamos de ti!


O que precisas para ter o nosso CODE:


  • Licenciatura em Engenharia Informática/Matemática/Estatística ou similar;
  • 4+ anos de experiência profissional no desenvolvimento em Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc;

- Acompanhamento personalizado. Preocupamo-nos com o teu bem-estar e desenvolvimento. Queremos proporcionar-te o equilíbrio certo entre a tua vida pessoal e profissional, queremos ver-te evoluir.

- Trabalhamos com um objetivo. Somos flexíveis no horário e oferecemos a possibilidade de trabalho remoto. O importante é cumprires os teus objetivos e sentires-te realizado.

- Investimos na tua carreira. Damos-te acesso a formação certificada, plataformas online e centro de exames Pearson VUE.

- Experiência e destaque no mercado tecnológico. A CodeWin pertence a um grupo multinacional com 24 marcas, mais de 7.000 colaboradores e presença em 14 países.

- Um conjunto de benefícios para o teu dia-a-dia. Seguro de saúde, seguro de vida e acidentes pessoais, um leque de descontos e benefícios, plano de telecomunicações e muito mais.

- Damos importância ao que realmente importa. Disponibilizamos-te consultas gratuitas de medicina geral, nutrição e psicologia.


Queremos marcar pela diferença com as nossas ideias e soluções. Para isso, precisamos de ti e de unir as nossas forças. Aceitas o desafio?


All in the right place


*Na CodeWin, defendemos a igualdade e valorizamos a diversidade. Criamos um ambiente seguro, diversificado, onde as oportunidades são iguais para todos os colaboradores! Não discriminamos com base em idade, etnia, orientação sexual, género, deficiência ou qualquer fator que não seja o mérito. Todas as candidaturas com competências para o cargo são bem-vindas!

In a nutshell 🥜

Are you passionate about data and enjoy turning complex datasets into clear, actionable insights? Do you want to build reliable data pipelines, scalable data models and intuitive analytics solutions that help businesses make better decisions?

As a Data & Analytics Engineer, you will bridge the gap between data engineering and business intelligence. You will design and develop robust data pipelines, structure data in Google BigQuery and create the semantic and visualisation layers that make data accessible to business users.

At b.telligent, you will work on challenging customer projects across different industries, collaborate closely with experienced data and analytics specialists, and help organisations build modern, data-driven solutions.

In this role, you will closely work with and be an integral part of our partner company emnos for which you will deliver the services described here within.

emnos is part of the b.telligent network

emnos is a global leading provider of an Al-based Retail Analytics B2B platform for retailers and their suppliers. It enables emnos to globally support joint, data-driven optimization of decisions in Category Management and Retail Media, mainly driven from clients’ consumer experience. The platform focuses on secure and efficient exchange of information and analysis between retailers and their suppliers, creating new business opportunities and revenue streams.

Your responsibilities


Design, develop and maintain reliable ETL and ELT pipelines using Python, SQL and Airflow or Google Cloud Composer
Build and optimise scalable data models in Google BigQuery
Apply data-modelling concepts such as star schemas, snowflake schemas and dimensional modelling
Develop data transformations and analytics-ready datasets for downstream consumption
Translate complex data structures into intuitive semantic layers and visualisations
Create dashboards and reports with Looker, Yellowfin or comparable BI tools
Work closely with customers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and define relevant KPIs
Turn business requirements into practical analytics solutions and actionable insights
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data architectures, engineering standards and best practices
Use Databricks and Apache Spark where appropriate for advanced data processing and lakehouse scenarios
Document technical solutions, data models and operational processes


Your profile


Professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence or a comparable role
Strong knowledge of Python and advanced SQL skills
Practical experience developing ETL and ELT pipelines
Experience with Apache Airflow or Google Cloud Composer
Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery and modern data-warehousing concepts
Knowledge of data modelling, including star and snowflake schemas
Experience with Looker, Yellowfin or another enterprise BI and visualisation tool
Familiarity with dbt or similar transformation frameworks is an advantage
Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark or lakehouse architectures is a plus
A structured, analytical and solution-oriented approach
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
Fluent English and Portuguese; German is an advantage
Enjoyment of working with customers and collaborating across technical and business teams


What to expect


A full-time position based in Porto, Portugal
A hybrid working model with office collaboration and home-office flexibility
Challenging customer projects across different industries
The opportunity to help shape modern data platforms and analytics solutions
Collaboration with experienced data, analytics and cloud specialists
Support for professional development and relevant certifications
Opportunities to attend conferences and community events
A collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous learning


Ready to turn data into impact?

Do you want to build modern data platforms, create meaningful analytics solutions and help customers make better decisions with data? Join b.telligent in Porto as our next Data & Analytics Engineer.

Apply now and become part of a collaborative team that combines data engineering, analytics and business expertise to create real value. We look forward to meeting you!

Advanced Python, including object-oriented programming, pandas and testing frameworks.

Experience with a data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, GCP or Azure.
Workflow orchestration using Airflow, Prefect or Dagster.
Excellent written and spoken English.

Description:
We are growing. And we are looking for talented people.

At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent.

We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives.

As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams.




We would like to meet an ETL Developer for a project with a hybrid working model in Porto, Portugal (2x/week at the office).




Responsabilities:

Design, build, and operate ETL pipelines that import tariff and customs nomenclature data from European and North American authorities via REST APIs, bulk file downloads, and web crawling/scraping
Develop resilient web crawling logic for portals without APIs, including change detection, pagination handling, rate limiting, and graceful failure recovery
Analyze source data structures per jurisdiction, including nomenclature hierarchies, duty measures, validity periods, legal references, and country-specific extensions
Design and evolve the relational data model (PostgreSQL), balancing normalization, query performance, and divergent national schemas
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and data versioning to accurately track tariff changes over time
Monitor pipeline health, investigate data anomalies, and adapt pipelines when authorities change publication formats
Document data lineage, source peculiarities, and data mapping decisions
Collaborate with customs domain experts and the engineering team to align the data model with operational and regulatory requirements




Requirements:

5+ years of experience as an ETL Developer, Data Engineer, BI Developer, or in a similar data engineering role.
Proven experience building production ETL/data pipelines in Python (e.g., requests/httpx, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Playwright, pandas, SQLAlchemy)
Hands-on experience consuming REST APIs and building web crawlers/scrapers, including authentication, throttling, and handling unstable data sources
Strong SQL skills and practical experience with relational data modeling, ideally using PostgreSQL
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to understand complex, poorly documented data sources and identify their structure, semantics, and edge cases
Strong interest in data modeling and database schema design
Ability to own data sources end-to-end, from analysis and implementation to monitoring, working independently
Experience working with XML, JSON, and CSV datasets at scale




Nice to Have:

Working knowledge of Java
Experience with Apache NiFi or similar data integration/dataflow platforms
Experience with data versioning and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)

Title: Data Quality Analyst (AI Model Data Analyst)
Description:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Location: Portugal (1-2 days in office per week)

Travel: Occasional international travel may be required.

Salary: €16,000–€20,000 per annum

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using deep-learning computer vision. Focal has been deployed at scale with the top retailers in the world. We are looking for smart, creative, and passionate people who love to learn, enjoy thinking critically, share our values, and want to build a great and enduring company.

We have built the next-generation operating system for brick & mortar retail. This OS leverages shelf-mounted cameras that constantly measure the state of the retailers’ shelves and use that information to order quicker and smarter, planogram better, and schedule, direct, train, and manage their staff. We have proven this with major retailers around the world.

Job Description

The quality of our computer-vision models depends entirely on the quality of the data they learn from. We are seeking a dedicated Data Quality Analyst to clean, review, and curate the training data that powers our systems. In this role you will assume accountability for the accuracy and consistency of our datasets, directly improving how well our models detect products. Meticulous attention to detail, strong data-handling skills, and the ability to meet quality and speed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are essential.

What You Will Be Doing


Review, clean, and correct labelled image and product data used to train our computer-vision models.
Identify and fix mislabelled, inconsistent, or low-quality data, and flag systematic errors in the labelling pipeline.
Conduct routine quality-assurance checks to catch data issues before they reach model training.
Onboard and scan products into the system, ensuring catalogue and reference data are accurate and complete.
Compare model predictions against ground truth to surface edge cases and areas where the model underperforms.
Work collaboratively with the machine-learning and operations teams to improve labelling guidelines and data standards.
Meet or exceed speed and quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) consistently.
Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members, providing updates on progress and raising any issues or challenges encountered.


Requirements:


Strong attention to detail and a genuine care for data accuracy and consistency.
Comfort working with large volumes of data, spreadsheets, and data-review or annotation tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to spot patterns and root-cause data errors.
